title: Red Desert RV Park

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Our 53 RV sites are all full-service sites which include 50/30/20 amp power, water, sewer, cable TV, and Wifi. We have 39 pull-through sites and 14 back-in sites. Our newly constructed bathhouse in the center of the park has bathrooms, showers, and guest laundry available
